title: 2018 Leibovich modèle pour Renal Cell Carcinoma (RCC)
abbreviations: 2018 Leibovich Model for Renal Cell Carcinoma
formula:
Scoring of features for clear cell RCC (ccRCC) is as follows:

| Variable | Progression-Free Survival | Cancer-Specific Survival |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Age at surgery, years | | |
| <60 | - | 0 |
| ≥60 | - | 1 |
| [ECOG](nabda:calc.eastern-cooperative-oncology-group-ecog-performance-status\) status | | |
| 0 | - | 0 |
| ≥1 | - | 2 |
| Constitutional symptoms | | |
| No | 0 | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | 1 |
| Adrenalectomy | | |
| No | - | 0 |
| Yes | - | 1 |
| Surgical margins | | |
| Negative | - | 0 |
| Positive | - | 1 |
| Tumor grade | | |
| 1 | 0 | 0 |
| 2 | 2 | 2 |
| 3 | 3 | 3 |
| 4 | 3 | 4 |
| Coagulative necrosis | | |
| No | 0 | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | 2 |
| Sarcomatid differentiation | | |
| No | 0 | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | 3 |
| Tumor size, cm | | |
| ≤4 | 0 | 0 |
| >4 to ≤7 | 3 | 4 |
| >7 to ≤10 | 4 | 4 |
| >10 | 4 | 5 |
| Perinephric/renal sinus fat invasion | | |
| No | 0 | 0 |
| Yes | 1 | 2 |
| Tumor thrombus* | | |
| No | 0 | 0 |
| Level 0 | 1 | 0 |
| Level 1-4 | 2 | 1 |
| Extension beyond kidney | | |
| No | 0 | - |
| Yes | 2 | - |
| Nodal involvement | | |
| No nodal dissection | 0 | 0 |
| No | 0 | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | 2 |

*Tumor thrombus level was defined by the[Neves and Zincke](https://bjui-journals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1111/j.1464-410X.1987.tb04832.x)classification.

Scoring of features for papillary RCC (papRCC) is as follows:

| Risk Group | Features |
| --- | --- |
| Group 1 | Tumor grade 1-2 No fat invasion No tumor thrombus |
| Group 2 | Tumor grade 3 No fat invasion No tumor thrombus |
| Group 3 | Tumor grade 4 or Fat invasion or Presence of tumor thrombus |

Scoring of features for chromophobe RCC (chrRCC) is as follows:

| Risk Group | Features |
| --- | --- |
| Group 1 | No fat invasion No sarcomatoid differentiation No nodal involvement |
| Group 2 | Fat invasion No sarcomatoid differentiation No nodal involvement |
| Group 3 | Sarcomatoid differentiation or Nodal involvement and/or Fat invasion |

how_to_use.why:
- Estimates 5‑, 10‑ and 15‑year progression‑free (PFS) and cancer‑specific survival (CSS) from the date of surgery, which can guide surveillance imaging schedules and decisions on adjuvant therapy or trial enrollment.
- Uses clinicopathologic data readily available after surgical resection.
- Outperforms pathologic staging alone.
- Incorporates the three most common RCC subtypes, whereas many models address only ccRCC.
- Used for clinical trial selection.
- Recommended in the[2024 European Association of Urology (EAU) guidelines on renal cell carcinoma](https://uroweb.org/guidelines/renal-cell-carcinoma).
how_to_use.when: À appliquer après une néphrectomie partielle ou radicale pour un carcinome à cellules rénales (RCC) localisé ou localement avancé, non métastatique, une fois les résultats anatomopathologiques définitifs disponibles, afin de stratifier le risque de progression et de décès.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Originally published in 2003 and revised in 2018 to reflect contemporary pathology and outcomes.
- The Mayo Clinic derivation cohort was predominantly White, although subsequent external validations demonstrate broader applicability.
- Scoring is independent of evolving American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) staging, relying instead on specific pathologic features.

next_steps.advice:
- This tool should be used in conjunction with clinical expertise, specialist consultation, and patient preferences to direct treatment and monitoring.
- In general, risk estimates can guide:

 - Surveillance intensity.
 - Adjuvant therapy use, including immunotherapies.
 - Prognosis counselling.
 - Comorbidity management.
- Scores may also identify individuals who are appropriate for clinical trials.
